title: Unclear if processing model of <input type=image> matches implementaions

labels.name: interop
labels.description: Implementations are not interoperable with each other

body:
[Spec](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#image-button-state-(type=image)) says `<input type=image>` tries to load the image when any of following events occur,
> - the input element's type attribute is first set to the Image Button state (possibly when the element is first created), and the src attribute is present
> -  the input element's type attribute is changed back to the Image Button state, and the src attribute is present, and its value has changed since the last time the type attribute was in the Image Button state
> -  the input element's type attribute is in the Image Button state, and the src attribute is set or changed

But I ran [the test](https://software.hixie.ch/utilities/js/live-dom-viewer/?%3C!DOCTYPE%20html%3E%0A%3Cinput%20type%3D%22image%22%20src%3D%22image%22%3E%0A%3Cscript%3E%0Aonload%20%3D%20function()%20%7B%0A%20%20let%20input%20%3D%20document.querySelector(%22input%22)%3B%0A%20%20input.onload%20%3D%20function()%20%7B%0A%20%20%20%20w(%22onload%22)%3B%0A%20%20%7D%3B%0A%20%20document.body.append(input)%3B%0A%7D%3B%0A%3C%2Fscript%3E) in Firefox, Safari, Edge, Chrome and Opera on macOS, most of them, except Firefox, would reload image after it re-connect to the tree even if there is no attribute changed.
